problem: Given $X∼\text{Geom}(0.64),$ compute $P(X<5).$  Round your final answer to $4$ decimal places.

feedback.worked_solution:
If $X∼\text{Geom}(p),$ then $X$ has the following probability mass function:

$$
f(x)={\begin{aligned}(1-p)^{x-1}p, & x=1,2,3,… \\ 0, & \text{otherwise}\end{aligned}
$$

Here, $X∼\text{Geom}(\frac{1}{4}),$ so the distribution of $X$ in this case is

$$
f(x)={\begin{aligned}{(\frac{3}{4})}^{x-1}(\frac{1}{4}), & x=1,2,3,… \\ 0, & \text{otherwise}.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore,

$$
\begin{aligned}P(X\le 2) & =P(X\in {1,2}) \\  & =P(X=1)+P(X=2) \\  & =f(1)+f(2) \\  & ={(\frac{3}{4})}^{0}(\frac{1}{4})+{(\frac{3}{4})}^{1}(\frac{1}{4}) \\  & =\frac{7}{16}.\end{aligned}
$$
